rules.scope: pair existing session feedback mutation to private attachment custody
rules.sourceFind: reportFeedback:sessionByIdProcedure.input(reportFeedbackInputSchema).mutation(async({input:Cn,ctx:ei})=>{let ti=await buildSessionFeedbackDump(ei.accountId,ei.session),ni=AccountRegistry.getAccount(ei.accountId),ri=ni?.userId?await uploadSessionFeedbackDump(ei.accountId,ei.session.id,ti).catch(Cn=>{logger.alert(`[Feedback] Session dump upload failed; inlining the dump`,{accountId:ei.accountId,error:Cn,sessionId:ei.session.id})}):void 0;return fetchAuxAPI(`/voc/session-feedback`,{body:{accountId:ei.accountId,analyticsId:AccountRegistry.resolveAnalyticsId(ei.accountId),asideComponentVersion:DAEMON_VERSION,comment:Cn.comment,model:ei.session.model,reporter:ni?{email:ni.email,name:ni.name,userId:ni.userId}:void 0,...ri?{sessionDumpKey:ri}:{sessionDump:ti},sessionId:ei.session.id,status:ei.session.status,title:ei.session.title||`Untitled session`},fallbackErrorMessage:`Failed to submit session feedback.`,method:`POST`,output:sessionFeedbackResponseSchema})})

rules.find: async function uploadSessionFeedbackDump(Cn,ei,ti){let{key:ni,url:ri}=await fetchAuxAPIAuthenticated(Cn,`/voc/session-feedback/upload`,{body:{sessionId:ei},method:`POST`,output:sessionDumpUploadSchema}),ii=await fetch(ri,{method:`PUT`,headers:{"content-type":`application/json`},body:JSON.stringify(ti)});if(!ii.ok)throw Error(`Session dump upload failed (${ii.status})`);return ni}
